'''Lorain''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Pureblood]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Blademaster of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
In [[3636 BBY]] she was on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] when former Sith Emperor [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] came to the world and possessed many of the Imperials on the planet, turning them into his puppets to murder civilians. Lorain was among those who fell under his control and she was killed during the fighting.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Blademaster Lorain was added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' in game update 3.2.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
